english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for people or things separating or being divided.

exampleSentences.english: It was time for us to part after dinner.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 fan1 hoi1 laa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for dividing things or people, including saying that something has come apart by itself.

exampleSentences.english: I separate the cookies into two plates.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 beng2 fan1 hoi1 loeng5 dip6

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when people or things physically separate or go apart.

exampleSentences.english: They diverge at the street corner and each go home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋行到街口就分開，各自返屋企。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 haang4 dou3 gaai1 hau2 zau6 fan1 hoi1 gok3 zi6 faan1 uk1 kei2

english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for physically splitting or separating things.

exampleSentences.english: We divide the room with a screen.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋用屏風將個房間分開。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 ping4 fung1 zoeng1 go3 fong2 gaan1 fan1 hoi1
